hints.title: Partitioning Array into Constant Capacity Blocks
hints.text: Allowing k resizing operations partitions the array into at most k + 1 contiguous blocks.

hints.title: Wasted Space per Subarray Block
hints.text: For a block from index i to j, the minimum capacity is max(nums[i..j]), and wasted space is max * length - sum.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming across Segments
hints.text: Compute dp[i][resizes] representing the minimum wasted space covering the prefix up to index i using a given number of resizes.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of array nums (up to 200)
complexity.notes: Segment dynamic programming with precomputed interval block costs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all partitions of N into K parts has combinatorial complexity C(N, K).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing O(N^2) block costs accelerates dynamic transition evaluation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should formulate the interval cost and build the standard 2D partition DP.
